meta.title: NBA Match Outcome Forecast
meta.data_source: NBA official stats API (stats.nba.com) via the nba_api Python package
meta.data_source_short: stats.nba.com (NBA official stats), accessed with nba_api
meta.cv_scheme: rolling-origin cross-validation inside the training window (train 2021-22 -> validate 2022-23; train 2021-23 -> validate 2023-24; train 2021-24 -> validate 2024-25), mean validation log-loss.
meta.disclaimer: Educational course project for AMA2233. Probabilities are model estimates, not certainties, and are not betting advice. This site is not affiliated with the NBA.

model_labels.baseline_home: Baseline: always home (p = train home-win rate)
